headline: **34 of 34 measurable public segments (10 scrolls) are inside the scan tolerance where a 9 µm model still reads Paris 4 letters.** Tiers: 2 read, 14 test, 18 transfer-limited, 0 scan-limited; 1 more had too little valid surface to measure. On every scroll with a WEAK verdict the scan is inside the tolerance, so the gap is model transfer, not scan quality.
